import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix, vstack
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
with open("./input/train/train.json", "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
with open("./input/test/test.json", "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)

train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)
y = (train_df["requester_received_pizza"] == True).astype(int)

# Text preprocessing
train_df["text"] = (
    train_df["request_title"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + train_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
)
test_df["text"] = (
    test_df["request_title"].fillna("")
    + " "
    + test_df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("")
)


# Discourse features: politeness, apology, reciprocation markers
def extract_discourse_features(text_series):
    features = []
    for text in text_series.fillna(""):
        if not isinstance(text, str):
            text = ""
        text_lower = text.lower()
        word_count = len(text.split()) if text.strip() else 1

        politeness_count = sum(
            text_lower.count(word)
            for word in ["please", "kindly", "thank you", "appreciate"]
        )
        politeness_ratio = politeness_count / word_count

        apology_count = sum(
            text_lower.count(word) for word in ["sorry", "apologize", "apology"]
        )
        apology_ratio = apology_count / word_count

        reciprocation_count = sum(
            text_lower.count(word)
            for word in ["offer", "return", "repay", "favor", "help you"]
        )
        reciprocation_ratio = reciprocation_count / word_count

        features.append([politeness_ratio, apology_ratio, reciprocation_ratio])
    return np.array(features)


print("Extracting discourse features...")
X_train_discourse = extract_discourse_features(train_df["text"])
X_test_discourse = extract_discourse_features(test_df["text"])

# Numeric features
numeric_features = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]

for col in numeric_features:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        train_df[col] = train_df[col].fillna(train_df[col].median())
        test_df[col] = test_df[col].fillna(test_df[col].median())

train_df["engagement_score"] = (
    train_df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"] + 1
) / (train_df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"] + 1)
test_df["engagement_score"] = (
    test_df["requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request"] + 1
) / (test_df["requester_number_of_comments_at_request"] + 1)

train_df["activity_per_day"] = (
    train_df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1
) / (train_df["requester_account_age_in_days_at_request"] + 1)
test_df["activity_per_day"] = (test_df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1) / (
    test_df["requester_account_age_in_days_at_request"] + 1
)

train_df["raop_ratio"] = train_df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] / (
    train_df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1
)
test_df["raop_ratio"] = test_df["requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request"] / (
    test_df["requester_number_of_posts_at_request"] + 1
)

interaction_cols = ["engagement_score", "activity_per_day", "raop_ratio"]
numeric_features_with_interactions = numeric_features + [
    c for c in interaction_cols if c in train_df.columns
]

X_train_numeric = train_df[numeric_features_with_interactions].values
X_test_numeric = test_df[numeric_features_with_interactions].values

# TF-IDF
print("Extracting TF-IDF text features...")
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=150, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english", min_df=2
)
X_train_text_tfidf = tfidf.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_test_text_tfidf = tfidf.transform(test_df["text"])

# Scaling
print("Scaling features...")
scaler_numeric = StandardScaler()
X_train_numeric_scaled = scaler_numeric.fit_transform(X_train_numeric)
X_test_numeric_scaled = scaler_numeric.transform(X_test_numeric)

# Combine all features (sparse)
print("Combining features...")
X_train = hstack(
    [
        X_train_text_tfidf,
        csr_matrix(X_train_numeric_scaled),
        csr_matrix(X_train_discourse),
    ]
)
X_test = hstack(
    [
        X_test_text_tfidf,
        csr_matrix(X_test_numeric_scaled),
        csr_matrix(X_test_discourse),
    ]
)

# Convert to dense for processing
X_train_dense = X_train.toarray()
X_test_dense = X_test.toarray()

# 3-way split: train (70%), validation (15%), held-out for final metric (15%)
print("Creating 3-way split...")
X_train_full, X_temp, y_train_full, y_temp = train_test_split(
    X_train_dense, y, test_size=0.30, random_state=42, stratify=y
)
X_val, X_holdout, y_val, y_holdout = train_test_split(
    X_temp, y_temp, test_size=0.50, random_state=42, stratify=y_temp
)

print(
    f"Train: {len(y_train_full)}, Validation (for ES): {len(y_val)}, Hold-out: {len(y_holdout)}"
)

X_train_sparse = csr_matrix(X_train_full)
X_val_sparse = csr_matrix(X_val)
X_holdout_sparse = csr_matrix(X_holdout)

# Train LightGBM with early stopping on validation set
print("Training LightGBM base model with early stopping...")
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train_sparse, y_train_full)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val_sparse, y_val, reference=lgb_train)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

base_model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

print(f"Best iteration: {base_model.best_iteration}")

# Train final base model on training set only with best iterations
print("Training final base model on training set...")
final_base = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=base_model.best_iteration,
    objective="binary",
    num_leaves=31,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    feature_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_fraction=0.8,
    bagging_freq=5,
    verbose=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
final_base.fit(X_train_sparse, y_train_full)

# Calibrate on hold-out set (truly unseen during training and early stopping)
print("Calibrating classifier on hold-out set...")
calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(final_base, method="isotonic", cv="prefit")
calibrated.fit(X_holdout_sparse, y_holdout)

# Final validation on truly hold-out set (no data leakage)
val_pred_calibrated = calibrated.predict_proba(X_holdout_sparse)[:, 1]
auc_final = roc_auc_score(y_holdout, val_pred_calibrated)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (on hold-out set): {auc_final:.6f}")

# Final calibrated model on training data only for submission
print("Training final calibrated model on training data for submission...")
final_train_calibrated = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    final_base, method="isotonic", cv="prefit"
)
final_train_calibrated.fit(X_train_sparse, y_train_full)

# Predictions for test set
print("Generating test predictions...")
X_test_sparse = csr_matrix(X_test_dense)
test_pred = final_train_calibrated.predict_proba(X_test_sparse)[:, 1]

# Save submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_pred}
)
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
